newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to partly offload shares of oil cos.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to partly offload shares of oil cos.

text.p: Bangladesh said on Sunday that it had no plan to privatise state-owned oil marketing companies, but it could only offload part of their shares in the capital market.
"Steps have been taken to restructure the capital base of these companies to offload some portions of shares," Energy Minister Noor Uddin Khan told the parliament. He gave no other details.
The three oil marketing companies are Padma Oil Co, Meghna Petroleum Ltd and Jamuna Oil Co. The government also owns the country's lone oil refinery.
